description: Originally organized as Caterpillar Tractor Co. in 1925 in California and reorganized as Caterpillar Inc. in 1986 in Delaware, Caterpillar Inc., with 2025 sales and revenues of $67.589 billion, is shaping the future as the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. Backed by one of the largest independent global dealer networks and financing services through Cat Financial, its primary business segments of Power & Energy, Construction Industries and Resource Industries solve customers' toughest challenges through commercial excellence and advanced technology, driven by a highly skilled, dedicated global team, and in 2025 the company introduced a revised strategy anchored by a new mission statement.
